title: Captain of the day — content/captains.json
description: The lives the front door may name Captain of the day, one a day in turn. The editor picks this list by hand: nobody is cast as a captain by default. The card prints only what the person's own entry says.

crew.description: Life ids, from content/lives/, in the order they take the bridge. Every id must be on the shelf; `npm run check` refuses one that is not. Empty, and the front door shows the specimen instead.
